checkpoint: Phase 4 human role: progress is understandable and provisional content cannot be confused with the authoritative final response
method: Offline transcript instead of curl. With generation disabled, curl receives only HTTP 503 generation_disabled and no events; seeing events over curl needs a paid live call, which was not authorized. The transcript was captured from the real stream endpoint driven by the Phase 4 test fakes (fake model, stubbed one-recipe lookup, no paid calls, no database).
attribution: Answers drafted by an external AI assistant from the transcript and a plain-language explainer written by Claude; the owner read them and explicitly agreed. Not a live-model evaluation.
scenarios: 2. model selects a recipe it was not given: stages, one error 502 validation_rejected, no final
3. request edited mid-stream: stages, one error 409 stale_revision, no final

progress_understandable.note: With the stage-name table the sequence is understandable (accepted, readiness, helper consultation, retrieval, evidence, model request/response, validation, revision check); detail counts match the stages.

nothing_before_final_mistakable_for_reco.note: No stage event contains ingredients, instructions or recommendation text; the recipe appears only in the final event of recording 1.

error_endings_clear.note: Both failure streams end with exactly one error and no final. Recording 3 states the problem and the action (refetch and retry). Recording 2 states the problem but its message does not tell the user what to do next.

finding.summary: Error messages state the failure but not the next action.
finding.scope_observed: validation_rejected in recording 2; the same holds for most non-409 recommendation errors (provider, schema, corpus, configuration).
finding.note: A blanket 'Please retry' would be wrong for configuration failures (authentication, generation disabled), where a retry cannot succeed. Fix design is pending owner decision.
finding.resolution: 2026-09-27, owner-approved proposal: every failure body with a reason and every stream error event carries next_action (retry | refetch_and_retry | change_request | contact_operator), mapped per reason in domain/recommendations.py; messages unchanged. Tests: tests/test_next_action.py. The reviewed transcript predates the fix.

not_covered: live model streaming (live smoke prepared in docs/phase4-live-smoke.md, not run)
client disconnect and keep-alive behaviour (covered by offline tests only)
